Name: Central American Goods CAG - Salvadoran Delights
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/RpM5J0R/Mod-Logo.png[/img]
[size=2]Add crop and goods into your game, featuring some important foods in Central America and El Salvador. Enjoy cooking, harvesting and crafting![/size]

This is my Salvadoran take on stuff, don't come at me, I cook stuff weirdly >->
Also idk how to balance stuff, bare with me, I cannot maths.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img]
List of compatibilities~
[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Recolours ----[/size]
As the items, trees and crops are modded they are not compatible with recolours that change vanilla objects.
However this mod makes its seed packets (they are seedlings but anyway) and saplings follow [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] - Farming style if it is installed.

[size=3]---- Ingredient Adding Mods ----[/size]
Recipes have been modified to include some ingredients if the following mods are present:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia Artisan Machines[/url]
Novaphene's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27697]Cook's Tools - More Kitchen Appliances[/url]

[size=2]---- Similar Items ----[/size]
They shouldn't conflict due to naming.

[size=3]---- Gift Tastes ----[/size]
Context tags have been placed for certain foods.
This include tags used by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSVO[/url]
Some allergen tags that I could think of and match with other mods

Meat-containing recipes (when [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] is present) are considered non-meat if Aimon's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27938]Soy Bean Meats[/url] is present.

[size=3]---- SVE ----[/size]
Yes, it should work with SVE.
No, I am not adding any active support for compatibility.

Custom NPCs should like most items, I made the tastes mostly universal >->[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3vBx7vz/configuration.png[/img]
Make sure to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] so you can check your configs easier~
Read carefully!
[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Game Immersion ----[/size]
Change aspects for the immersion to the world of SDV.

[spoiler]
[b]Country and Region Name Changes:[/b] Change between using real names of countries and regions, or names and regions that fit better into the world of Stardew Valley. (Does not affect the scientific names used)
(Default is 'SDV Fantasy Names')

[b]Where did the Recipe Plot option go?
[/b]Well, it is now not optional >:) I really wanted to have the secret notes be a big part of gathering the recipes and getting a special power at the end.[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Changing Craftable Style ----[/size]
Change the way the big craftable 'Imported Kitchen Counter' looks like.
[spoiler]
[b]Wood Colour:[/b] You can choose between Black, Dark Brown, Brown, Light Brown, White, Pastel Purple, Joja Blue, Vanilla.
(Default is 'Dark Brown')

[b]Tile Colour:[/b] You can choose between Cream White, Pale Blue, Soft Green, Pastel Pink, Joja White, Vanilla Gray.
(Default is 'White')

[b]Decorations' Colour:[/b] You can choose between Community Center Colours, Joja Colours or simply turning the decorations off.
(Default is 'Community Center Colours')

Alternatively an AT file is provided in optional files.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JzvFMLL/what-is-added.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#ff0000]Spoilers for the mod ahead, continue with precaution.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3]---- Crops ----[/size]
[b]Loroco:[/b] Grows in Summer and Falls.
[spoiler]
(Flowers all the way to winter.)
10 days to grow, harvested every 3 days.
[u]Produces:[/u] Loroco Flower Branch and Loroco Flower Buds

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[b]Yucca Cane (Izote):[/b] Grows in Spring and Summer.
[spoiler]
(Flowers all the way to fall.)
28 days to grow, harvested every 2 days.
[u]Produces:[/u] Izote Flower Branch and Izote Flower Petals

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.

Note: Made for planting in Spring (recommended), not made into bush because you may get a Giant![/spoiler]

[b]Pacaya:[/b] Grows only in Spring.
[spoiler]
14 days to grow, harvested every 2 days.
[u]Produces:[/u] Pacaya Flower Bundle

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

A Special [b]Mangrove [/b]is available in various locations if a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23417]certain mod[/url] is present.
(Needs [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url] as they can ONLY be planted in water)
[spoiler]
There are two types - but are essentially the same.
[u]Produces:[/u] fiber, but can also produce other items randomly.

Grows in any season except Winter (It can survive and produce during winter though)
Takes about 56 days to grow.

Note: Sometimes the texture goes yeet, I am still trying to see why :([/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Fruit Trees ----[/size]
[b]Pitos:[/b] Produces during Spring and Winter.
[spoiler]
Cannot be planted during Winter.
(Yes, this makes sense)
[u]Produces:[/u] Pitos Flowers.

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[b]Madre Cacao (Gliricidia):[/b] Produces during Spring.
[spoiler]
Cannot be planted during Winter.
[u]Produces:[/u] Madre Cacao Flowers.

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[b]Great Bougainvillea (Veranera):[/b] Produces during Spring, Summer, and Fall.
[spoiler]
Cannot be planted during Winter.
[u]Produces:[/u] Great Bougainvillea Flowers.

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[b]Pink Shower Tree (Carao):[/b] Produces during Summer.
[spoiler]
Cannot be planted during Winter.
[u]Produces:[/u] Carao Pod

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[b]Calabash Tree (Morro):[/b] Produces during Spring, Summer, and Fall.
[spoiler]
Cannot be planted during Winter.
[u]Produces:[/u] Morro Fruit and Dry Morro Fruit

Found at Pierre's, Sandy's and the Traveling Cart - randomly, prices may vary.[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Forageables ----[/size]
[b]Cochinito[/b]
[spoiler]
Found in areas that are not majorly sandy.
Not found in the desert.
Found in Spring, Summer and Fall.
About a 10% chance of spawning.

Can sometimes be sold by Marnie.[/spoiler]

[b]Papelillo[/b]
[spoiler]
Found in areas that are not majorly sandy.
Not found in the desert.
Found in Spring, Summer and Fall.
About a 10% chance of spawning.

Can sometimes be sold by Marnie.[/spoiler]

[b]Tenquique[/b]
[spoiler]
Found in areas that are not majorly sandy.
Not found in the desert.
Found in Spring, Summer and Fall.
About a 10% chance of spawning.

Can sometimes be sold by Marnie.[/spoiler]

[b]Fishing[/b]
[spoiler]
Polyester Cup (becomes slightly more common in the Joja Route)
Pupusas' Plate
Dry Morro Fruit (Whole)[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Big Craftables and Artisan Goods ----[/size]
[b]From Garbage Cans[/b]
[spoiler]
Polyester Cup can sometimes be found.
It can also be fished out.[/spoiler]

[b]For Recycling Machine[/b]
[spoiler]
Polyester Cup into Refined Quartz.
Pupusas' Plate into Refined Quartz.[/spoiler]

[b]For Dehydrator[/b]
[spoiler]
Morro Fruit into Dry Morro Fruit (Can be Whole or Half)[/spoiler]

[b]For Preserves Jar[/b]
[spoiler]
10 Loroco Flower Buds into Pickled Loroco Flower Buds[/spoiler]

[b]For Keg
[/b](If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]﻿ is present)
[spoiler]
1 coal + 5 Sugarcane into Aguardiente (Firewater)
Add the coal in and have the 5 sugarcane present in your inventory!
(Now requires Extra Machine Config [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]EMC[/url])
(If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]﻿ is not present, it can be bought at the Saloon)[/spoiler]

[b]Cleaning Stool:[/b] Just a little stool to get to work.
[spoiler]
Can be crafted by default.

[u]Can process:[/u]
Loroco Flower Branch into Loroco Flower Buds.
Izote Flower Branch into Izote Flower Petals.
Dry Morro Fruit (Whole) into Dry Morro Fruit (Half).
Dry Morro Fruit (Half) into Morro Bowl.[/spoiler]

[b]Collector Net:[/b] Catch some flowers in this handy net, perhaps even some seeds.
(Needs [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url])
[spoiler]
Can be crafted after reaching Forage level 4.
Place on [u]this mod's[/u] 'fruit' trees to produce some of its flowers.
([u]Might[/u] add support for other modded flowering trees - but who knows).

Place on [u]vanilla wild trees[/u] to produce some of those tree's seeds.[/spoiler]

[b]Tenquique Mushroom Inoculated Bag:[/b] Naturally grow some mushrooms from this mod.
(Needs [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url])
[spoiler]
Can be crafted after reaching Forage level 2.
Place on an [u]Oak Tree[/u] to produce Tenquique Mushroom.

Place on a [u]Cashew Tree[/u] to produce Tenquique Mushroom.
(If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]﻿ or [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url] is present)

Place on a [u]Chestnut Tree[/u] to produce Tenquique Mushroom.
(If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes[/url] is present)[/spoiler]

[b]Imported Kitchen Counter: [/b]Mortar and pestle included, don't forget your seasonings.
(Needs [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url])
[spoiler]
Special menu counter for the recipes from this mod.
Sold at the Traveling Cart.

Sold at Robin's and at a reduced price at the Traveling Cart after completing the Community Center, and receiving a letter from Robin after reaching 7 hearts with her.[/spoiler]

[size=3]---- Recipes ----[/size]
About 22 recipes.

The [b]Frozen Tear Condensate[/b] recipe is sent by Gus.
[spoiler]
Buy Frozen Tear Condensate from the Saloon at least once.
Gus will send a letter after reaching 6 hearts with him.[/spoiler]

When [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] are present.
[spoiler]
A book for Edible Flowers will be available for purchase from the bookseller after finding the Magnifying Glass that allows for finding Secret Notes.
This book has a secret note that will fall after you read it.
After reading the note, various notes will be made available across different shops.
[spoiler]
[u]Shops:[/u]
Bookseller - 1100g
Traveling Cart - 2000g
Saloon - 1000g
Pierre's - 500g
Marnie's - 250g
Sandy - 750g
Willy - 150g

[u]Festivals:[/u]
Dance of the Moonlight Jellies Shop - 1050g
Flower Dance Shop - 950g
Luau Shop - 1250g
Festival of Ice Traveling Cart - 1550g
SDV Fair Token Stand - 2750 tokens[/spoiler]

As well as finding them out in the world :D
Once you have all these notes a mysterious letter will be sent to you.

[spoiler]
You can then check the traveling cart to buy 1 book half.
You will receive a letter telling you the other half is available at the traveling cart, and the crafting recipe for the recipe book.
After you purchase the other half, you can craft the recipe book.
After reading it you might earn a special buff.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

Recipes are randomly available for purchase at the Saloon
(If [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] are not present, but I made that unlikely :D)

[size=3]---- Buffs ----[/size]
[b]Culinary Secret[/b]
Has a 0.25% of being applied when eating one of the foods from this mod.
[spoiler]
Luck Level +1
Immunity +4
Knockback x5
Weapon Speed x2
Attack x2
Crit Chance x2
Crit Power x2

Is it overpowered? Maybe.
Will I change it? Maybe.
If you ask... Maybe not.[/spoiler]


[size=3]---- Special Orders ----[/size]
[b]Trash Problems [/b]
Special Order Requester: Linus 
[spoiler]
Similar to Community Cleanup.

Time frame: 14 days.
Fish out or collect 10 Polyester Cups and dump them in the bin at the train platform.
Reward: Friendship with Linus and 500g[/spoiler]

[b]Delight from 'Abroad'[/b]
Special Order Requester: Caroline
[spoiler]
Available after the dishes in the order are learnt.
Each season there is a request for a different set of dishes.

Time frame: 14 days.
Make the 4 dishes specified and deliver them to Caroline.
Reward: Friendship with Caroline and 8000 to 10,000g[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MpXMXFh/to-do.png[/img]
[size=2]CAG is planned to be a series![/size]
[spoiler]
- Will add pets and custom animals - possibly like critters.
- Will add more recipes, crops, and trees - and forageables :3
- Might add fishes, I don't like coding them
- Might add event
- Might probably possibly make an expansion (please stop me)[/spoiler]

The development of CAG series is not in high priority right now.
Please be patient ><
